definitions.short: the forward part (or relatively) East (often adverbially, on the east or in front)
definitions.full: H6926. qidmah [ קִדְמָה ] noun feminine front, East ; — only construct קִדְמַת as preposition: 1 in front of, over against (compare Nö ZMG xxxiii (1879), 532 ), Gen 2:14 (i.e. from standpoint of writer; really, on geographic grounds, = west of; yet see Di ed. 6 ), 4:16 (both J), 2 on the east of , Ezek 39:11 ; 1Sam 13:5 may be either.
